label: verified command/result excerpts; error text is a screening signal, not adjudicated failure

commands.command:
cd /app && python3 -c "
import language
# sanity: parse a tiny program
p=language.load('{\"cells\":{},\"inputs\":{},\"body\":[]}')
print('ok', p)
"

cd /app && cat > /tmp/makewit.py <<'EOF'
import json
wit = {
  "cells": {"box": {"types": ["int","text"], "value": 0}},
  "inputs": {},
  "body": [
    ["let","f",["fn",[],["fn",[],["lit",0]]]],
    ["let","g",["fn",[],["fn",[],["lit",0]]]],
    ["repeat",["lit",3],[
      ["assign","f",["var","g"]],
      ["assign","g",["fn",[],["fn",[["set","box",["lit","x"]]],["lit",0]]]]
    ]],
    ["let","h",["call",["var","f"]]],
    ["eval",["call",["var","h"]]],
    ["eval",["add",["get","box"],["lit",1]]]
  ]
}
open("/app/witness.json","w").write(json.dumps(wit))
print("written")
EOF
python3 /tmp/makewit.py && python3 /app/evaluate.py /app/witness.json; echo "EXIT=$?"

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
from language import load, validate
from checker import check
from interpreter import run

text = open('/app/witness.json').read()
print('bytes:', len(text.encode('utf-8')), '(limit 65536)')
p = load(text)                      # raises if invalid
print('nodes:', validate(p), '(limit 512)')
print('checker accepts:', check(p))
r = run(p)
print('runtime:', r['status'], 'steps:', r['steps'], '(limit 4096)')
print('message:', r.get('message'))
EOF
cd /app && python3 evaluate.py witness.json > /dev/null; echo "smoke exit=$?"; cat witness.json
